title: pr-brief diagram theme
description: beautiful-mermaid's DiagramColors (bg, fg and five optional colours) plus an optional status block.

fg.description: Text. Required. It needs a contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against bg and against the node fill.

line.description: Edges. Default: fg mixed 50% into bg.

accent.description: Accepted for beautiful-mermaid compatibility, where it colours arrowheads. Mermaid colours arrowheads like their edge, so it has no effect on a pr-brief diagram.

muted.description: Secondary text and group headers. Default: fg mixed 60% into bg.

surface.description: Node fill. Default: fg mixed 3% into bg.

border.description: Node and group stroke. Default: fg mixed 20% into bg.

status.description: Colours of added, modified and removed nodes. Default: green, amber and red tuned to the background's lightness.
